ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent conviction of a Minnesota non-profit leader for pilfering $250M meant for underserved children, and explore the wider issue of Medicaid fraud in the state
questions: How widespread is Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What steps are being taken to prevent future instances of fraud?
ideas.insight: The recent conviction in Minnesota is just the tip of the iceberg. By analyzing data and public records, we can uncover a larger pattern of Medicaid fraud in the state and explore ways to prevent future instances of fraud.
